changes.summary: Retained-power window after ignition off extended from 45 s to 60 s (door-open cutoff unchanged). This absorbs the deleted WLC-023, which already said 60 s and conflicted with the old WLC-007.
The trigger changed from the rain sensor to the CAN request WLC_CloseAll. The vague 'quickly' became express close with anti-pinch active. This is a new interface and a new safety condition.
Pinch detection threshold lowered from 100 N to 80 N. This makes false reversals more likely and changes the stop-time check point.
Minimum reversal distance increased from 125 mm to 150 mm. The 10 ms stop time and the 'or fully open' clause are unchanged.
'Set itself to not normalized' became 'set its state to not normalized'. The 500 ms limit and the behaviour are unchanged.
The vague 'limit' and 'safe value' are now concrete: the temperature threshold is 130 °C and the motor current limit is 15 A.
WLC_Status period shortened from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms. The content is unchanged. Bus load and queueing are affected.
Reduced to storing DTC B1A02 at more than 25 A for more than 50 ms. The 'stop motor' and 'set fault state' reactions moved to new requirements WLC-037 and WLC-038.

tests.reason: Remove the trace to deleted WLC-032 and keep the test, because it still verifies WLC-004; check that its 100 µA limit matches WLC-004, since the limit was only visible in WLC-032.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Movement at 50 s; no movement at 70 s; no movement after the front door is opened at 10 s. Remove the trace to deleted WLC-023.
tests.reason: The window is now 60 s, so the old 40 s and 50 s probes no longer straddle the limit; press at 50 s and 70 s instead.

tests.new_pass_criteria: With the window half open, on the CAN request WLC_CloseAll the window closes in express mode. With a pinch rod in the path, anti-pinch is active (pinch detected and reversed). A rain signal alone no longer closes the window.
tests.reason: The trigger changed from the rain signal to the CAN request WLC_CloseAll, and anti-pinch is now required during that close.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: The threshold and the reversal distance both changed.

tests.new_pass_criteria: As TC-AP-01: stop within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less, at 9.0 V.
tests.reason: It inherits the changed threshold and reversal distance through TC-AP-01.

tests.new_pass_criteria: As TC-AP-01: stop within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less, at 16.0 V.
tests.reason: It inherits the changed threshold and reversal distance through TC-AP-01.

tests.new_pass_criteria: As TC-AP-01 at 9.0 V and -30 °C: stop within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: It inherits the changed limits, and it is the cold and low-voltage worst case for stop time (LL-2022-02).

tests.new_pass_criteria: As TC-AP-01 at 13.5 V and 85 °C: stop within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: It inherits the changed threshold and reversal distance through TC-AP-01.
Remove the trace to deleted WLC-018, which was untestable, but keep and rerun the test and re-trace it to WLC-014, because the lower threshold raises the false-reversal risk (LL-2021-07).
The change is editorial; the 500 ms limit and the behaviour are the same.

tests.new_pass_criteria: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, motor current is limited to 15 A (no current above 15 A is drawn). Below 130 °C no limiting occurs.
tests.reason: The old criterion 'motor current reduced' is now a concrete 130 °C trigger and 15 A limit.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Period 50 ms ± 5 ms; all four signals present (window position, movement state, normalization state, fault state).
tests.reason: The period requirement changed, so the pass criteria must change.

tests.new_pass_criteria: With the window blocked and 27 A injected for 100 ms, B1A02 is stored (WLC-030), the motor is stopped (WLC-037) and the fault state is set in WLC_Status (WLC-038). Add a negative case: no B1A02 when current does not exceed 25 A or lasts no more than 50 ms.
tests.reason: WLC-030 now covers only the DTC storage, so re-trace the test to WLC-030, WLC-037 and WLC-038 and add a negative case.
It only traced the deleted, unmeasurable WLC-033, so it verifies nothing in the new version.

added.pass_criteria: After B1A02 is stored (27 A for 100 ms, window blocked), the motor is stopped and stays stopped. Not stored at 25 A or below, or at 50 ms or less: motor not stopped by this function.
After B1A02 is stored, the fault state signal in WLC_Status is set in the next frames (50 ms ± 5 ms period). It is not set when B1A02 is not stored.

added.extend_test: New test needed (suggest TC-AP-10; TC-AP-08 covers WLC-019 only)
added.pass_criteria: Trigger a pinch reversal. An express close request before 2 s has passed is not executed. An express close request after 2 s is executed. Also check that the inhibit does not block other movement such as manual close or open. The requirement gives no tolerance on 2 s, so probe with margin and ask for a tolerance.

concerns.concern: These are not traced to a changed requirement but run anti-pinch in manual and express mode, with no normalization, with repeated pinches and in climatic conditions. They use the 100 N threshold and 125 mm reversal, so rerun them, and check any hard-coded limits. TC-AP-08 must also be checked against the new WLC-039 2 s inhibit.

Per LL-2021-07, the lower threshold (80 N) needs a new check of both false reversals and stop time. Rerun TC-AP-09 on the rough-road profile and tie it to WLC-014, even though WLC-018 is deleted. Do not retire it.

Per LL-2022-02, the cold and low-voltage corner (9.0 V, -30 °C) is the worst case for stop time. Run it on every software release, not just once. Check that the 150 mm reversal is achievable at that corner.
The pinch rod sits at 100 mm and the reversal requirement is now 150 mm or fully open, whichever is less. Check the fixture geometry so the 'fully open' clause does not silently pass the test.

WLC_CloseAll is a new CAN input. Add a case for WLC_CloseAll while not normalized (WLC-013 and WLC-017 interplay) and while thermally blocked. Confirm that removing closing on rain is intended, because no test or requirement will cover the rain sensor any more.

Per LL-2024-01, the estimate-based limit check needs a current estimate, and the shared thermal module is also used by WLC-200. Check that the fix is present before the run. Check the 15 A limit against the WLC-030 25 A overcurrent threshold, and rerun TC-TH-03 and TC-TH-04 for any threshold change. Check that the 15 A limit does not prevent pinch detection or closing at 85 °C (TC-AP-05).

Per LL-2024-09, the cycle time is halved, so repeat the worst-case queue calculation. Add a run under worst bus load, including a diagnostic session, plus the WLC_CloseAll traffic. Keep the TC-DG-02 fault-state check consistent with the 50 ms period.

WLC-037 and WLC-038 are triggered by 'stored', which is not the same as 'detected', and they have no response time. Ask for a time limit and clarify whether the motor stays stopped while the DTC remains stored (for example across an ignition cycle). TC-DG-03 (diagnostic response time, WLC-031) should be rerun in case the reactions moved.
No change touches it, but per LL-2023-05 keep the Hall-sensor-removal test at the lowest supply voltage with the actuator running in the regression set.

The process requirement is deleted and has no test. Confirm that the process conformity evidence is still held somewhere else, such as an audit. The usability review TC-UX-01 could be kept as an informal check, but it is not a verification.
Confirm that WLC-004 itself states the sleep current limit. If it does not, the 100 µA limit may be left without a requirement.

added.WLC-039: After a pinch reversal, express close shall be inhibited for 2 s.
added.WLC-037: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall stop the motor.
added.WLC-038: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.

deleted.WLC-018: The anti-pinch function shall be robust against all disturbances.
deleted.WLC-023: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s.
deleted.WLC-032: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
deleted.WLC-033: The controller shall be user friendly.
deleted.WLC-034: The software shall be developed according to the company software process.

WLC-007.old: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 45 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.
WLC-007.new: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.

WLC-012.old: The window shall close quickly when the rain sensor reports rain.
WLC-012.new: When the body controller sends the CAN request WLC_CloseAll, the controller shall close the window in express mode, with anti-pinch protection active.

WLC-014.old: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 100 N.
WLC-014.new: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N.

WLC-015.old: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 125 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
WLC-015.new: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.

WLC-021.old: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set itself to not normalized.
WLC-021.new: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set its state to not normalized.

WLC-025.old: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds the limit, the controller shall reduce motor current to a safe value.
WLC-025.new: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, the controller shall limit motor current to 15 A.

WLC-028.old: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 100 ms ± 10 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.
WLC-028.new: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 50 ms ± 5 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.

WLC-030.old: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms and shall stop the motor and shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.
WLC-030.new: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms.
